data.name: Naveed
data.gender_notes: Naveed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Naveed is a Persian name that means 'good news' or 'glad tidings'. It is a popular name in many Islamic countries, symbolizing joy and happiness. The name Naveed carries the meaning “Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naveed usually hope their child will grow to embody good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Naveed is considered a blessed name, as it evokes the concept of spreading good news and sharing joy with others.
data.etymology: Naveed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naveed total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نوید

in_urdu.name: نوید
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوید ایک فارسی لفظ ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی خوشخبری اور خوشی ہے، اور اسے اسلامی روایت میں نیک بشارت اور فرحت کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: नवीद
